The only description of what’s coming upon you shall be BEAUTY -Part 3
?
Genesis 39:20 KJV
And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

We could therefore, say the following;?
?Joseph’s destiny was momentarily imprisoned.
?His vision was temporarily on hold..
?His dreams were fizzling out before him.
?It appeared he was helpless.
?It appeared the enemies were having the last laugh, but scriptures say in;?
Micah 7:8 MSG
Don’t, enemy, crow over me. I’m down, but I’m not out. I’m sitting in the dark right now, but God is my light.

His enemies crowed over him?
They concluded he was not only down, but also out.?
?They concluded he was sitting in the dark and he was going to be there for a looooooooong time, but, they were wrong.

✔Something was coming and it could only be described as BEAUTIFUL.

When his moment came, God gave him beauty for ashes.??

✔The moment you’ve been waiting for is here.
✔Your entire life will receive beauty for ashes✔Your business will receive beauty for ashes.
✔Your marriage will receive beauty for ashes.
✔Every ugliness in and around you will receive beauty for ashes.

The only word that will be used to describe you going forward will be BEAUTIFUL in Jesus name??????
